acceptance: `--force datagen` reaches the adapter as force_recreate=True on every SQL platform that reads it
Platforms that fail closed on force_recreate keep doing so, with the behaviour change documented
Unit test covers the CLI-to-adapter path for --force datagen
context: Found 2026-10-15 while adding the force_recreate platform option (PR #3013).
description: The CLI sets the runtime override `force_recreate` from `--force datagen` (`benchbox/cli/commands/run.py`, `_force_recreate_requested`), but runtime overrides land only in `database_config.options`. `get_platform_config` (`benchbox/core/platform_config.py`) lifts only explicit platform options to the top-level adapter config, and most adapters build their `force_recreate` from top-level `force` or `force_recreate`. A dry-run constructor probe on 2026-10-15 showed DuckDB, PostgreSQL, DataFusion and SQLite receiving `force_recreate=False`, and Snowflake receiving nothing, under `--force datagen`. So `--force datagen` regenerates data but does not recreate the database. The explicit `--platform-option force_recreate=true` (PR #3013) does work.
